author: phungpx
description:
CubiCasa5K (COCO format)
	

Instance-segmentation dataset of residential floor plans, converted to a
COCO-style schema and packaged as Parquet with embedded images. Each image is
annotated with polygon masks for architectural elements (walls, doors, windows,
rooms, fixtures, etc.).

Repository: phungpx/cubicassa5k-coco
Source dataset: CubiCasa5K
Format: COCO instance segmentation (polygon segmentation + bbox)
Modalities: image + structured annotations


	
		
	
	
		Dataset SummaryΓÇª See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/phungpx/cubicassa5k-coco.

author: cocolabs
description:
VybBench 1.0
	

Almost isn't good enough. VybBench measures how well models maintain
design fidelity by comparing how effectively they generate specific
fonts and colors, and perform non-destructive edits.
Our dataset consists of 145 fonts, 100 colors, and 200 edits. We have each model
perform each task three times and score each generation individually.
We compare top image generation models:
ChatGPT Image (gpt-image-2.5-sunburst), Meta Muse, and Recraft v4.1. We also report
theΓÇª See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/cocolabs/vybbench.
